steps.title: Create CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file that includes a header line "Destination Well, Transfer Volume" followed by rows for each well and the volume of water to add (e.g., A1,5; B1,2).

steps.title: Dilute sample according to CSV
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, keep the plate at 4 °C and use a multi‑channel pipette operated in single‑channel mode to dispense the listed transfer volume of water into the destination well, then mix the well by aspirating and dispensing the same volume three times.

substeps.instruction: Dispense the specified volume of water into the destination well
Mix by aspirating and dispensing the same volume three times
